# Huzaifa Sabah Uddin (Hexz): Freelance Python & Django Backend Developer

Also known as Hexz.

> Freelance backend developer who replaces a team's patchwork of paid SaaS tools with one owned, custom system. Custom internal tools, Django and REST API backends, automation and integrations, and Django rescue work. Projects from $500. Based in Karachi, Pakistan; works remotely with clients worldwide.

## Services

- HX-01 Custom internal tool: one owned Django system instead of overlapping project-management apps, chat bots and spreadsheets. Workspaces, roles and permissions, tasks with approvals, client portal, Slack/email/push alerts.
- HX-02 Django & REST API backend: multi-tenant SaaS and product backends. Django / DRF or FastAPI, PostgreSQL + PgBouncer, RBAC, Celery workers, Docker deploy.
- HX-03 Automation & integrations: Celery and cron jobs, Slack, Notion and Google Sheets bots, automated reports and dashboards.
- HX-04 Django rescue & scaling: query and N+1 fixes, connection pooling, Redis caching, Celery/Redis tuning, deployment hardening.

- HX-05 Django speed audit (fixed price): $300, delivered in 3 days. Written, prioritised report of what is slowing a Django app down and how to fix it.
- HX-06 One automation (fixed price): $500, delivered in 1 week. One workflow built and running: weekly report, reminder bot, Google Sheets or Notion sync to Slack or email.

Pricing: projects from $500, quoted after a short conversation. A free "Stack check" calculator on the site totals what a team spends on SaaS tools. Replies to enquiries within 24 hours.

## Work

- TopsoftDigitals Connect: real-time project management platform for a digital agency. Replaced Basecamp, Asana, Trello, Slack bots and spreadsheets; tooling cost dropped from ~$1,400/mo to ~$90/mo ($15,600/year saved, 94%). Django 6.1, Channels + Redis, PostgreSQL + PgBouncer, Celery, S3, Railway. (https://production.topsoftdigitals.pk/)
- Quillnest: his own SaaS product, a client project portal for studios and agencies: signed agreements, versioned files, live chat and client approvals, with multi-company and multi-brand workspaces. Django 6.1, Channels + Redis, PostgreSQL, Celery, S3, Railway. (https://usequillnest.com/)
- Blink Digitally Publishing Dashboard: ~6,000-line Streamlit dashboard that removed 12+ hours a week of manual reporting. Pandas, Matplotlib, Google Sheets API, Slack bot. (https://github.com/Iamhuzaifasabahuddin/BlinkDigitally)
- Cafe 1947 Website & Booking: online booking replacing a phone-and-paper system, synced to a Notion reservations ledger. (https://www.cafe-1947.com/)
